description: 追加华东销售区域筛选并保留时间和指标。

turns.question: 2025 年第一季度已完成订单的人民币销售额是多少？
turns.expected_sql:
SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
LEFT JOIN mart_sales.dim_date AS d
  ON d.date_key = f.completion_date_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01';

turns.question: 筛选销售区域为华东。
turns.expected_sql:
SELECT SUM(f.net_sales_amount_cny) AS net_sales_cny
FROM mart_sales.fct_sales_order_line AS f
LEFT JOIN mart_sales.dim_sales_region AS r
  ON r.sales_region_key = f.sales_region_key
LEFT JOIN mart_sales.dim_date AS d
  ON d.date_key = f.completion_date_key
WHERE f.order_status = 'completed'
  AND d.full_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.full_date < DATE '2025-04-01'
  AND r.sales_region_name = '华东';
